Then in `getchunk`:


`i + n + 4` = `16 + 18446744073709551615 + 4` = `18446744073709551635` which wraps around to `19` (mod 2^64). So `s.len < 19` - if `s.len` is >= 19, this check passes.

Then:
```c
if (s.ptr[i] != '\r' || s.ptr[i + 1] != '\n') return false;
if (s.ptr[i + n + 2] != '\r' || s.ptr[i + n + 3] != '\n') return false;
```

`s.ptr[i + n + 2]` = `s.ptr[16 + 18446744073709551615 + 2]` = `s.ptr[17]` (wraps around). So it reads `s.ptr[17]` and `s.ptr[18]`. If `s.len` is >= 19, these are in bounds. Hmm, so the overflow makes it read within bounds but at wrong positions.
